verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a first-party off-ramp: stablecoins can be converted to USD and withdrawn to a bank in one call (redeem orchestration). Payments can auto-convert to fiat and settle USD to a bank account, and the Fiat Transfers API supports withdrawals via Fedwire, SWIFT (international) and CUBIX. However, every documented payout is USD-only, so recipients cannot land in local fiat. Missing for 10: non-USD local-currency payouts, a published list of supported currencies and countries, local bank rails beyond wire/CUBIX, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
